goal: Forecast-only reproduction of author repository with explicit resource adaptations
paper_templates: config_paper/; prepared but not executed as final experiments
graph: Author bnh,nm->bnh retained; this sums adjacency rows rather than mixing nodes in DynamicGraphConv
split: Provided indices retained; adjacent target intervals overlap11steps; target-disjoint experiment not run

metric_protocol.MAE: unmasked for PEMS04/08, zero-masked for METR-LA/BAY
metric_protocol.MAPE: ratio; labels<0.01 excluded; result CSV presents percent

checkpoint: lowest sample-weighted validation loss, reload before test
pretraining: reuse unchanged author checkpoints; no full pretraining performed
precision: FP32, easy-torch TF32 disabled, no AMP, no gradient accumulation
scope: One100epoch main run and three15/2/1epoch exploratory runs; not full paper reproduction
